title: Contemplative Presence - Homeward Practice

blocks.label: Text: Present to God. Available to love.
blocks.value: Present to God. Available to love.

blocks.label: Text: Set aside five to ten quiet minutes. You may sit, stand by a window, or …
blocks.value: Set aside five to ten quiet minutes. You may sit, stand by a window, or walk slowly. The practice is not about creating a spiritual feeling. It is about becoming more present to the God who is already here.

blocks.label: Text: Feel the support beneath you. Notice your breathing. Let your shoulders …
blocks.value: Feel the support beneath you. Notice your breathing. Let your shoulders soften.

blocks.label: Text: Let yourself be loved before you improve, understand, or accomplish anyt…
blocks.value: Let yourself be loved before you improve, understand, or accomplish anything.

blocks.label: Text: Open your senses. What sounds, sensations, emotions, and needs are prese…
blocks.value: Open your senses. What sounds, sensations, emotions, and needs are present? Notice without judging or fixing.

blocks.label: Text: Bring to mind the person, place, or responsibility before you.
blocks.value: Bring to mind the person, place, or responsibility before you.

blocks.label: Text: Name one small way you can become available: attention, courage, a bound…
blocks.value: Name one small way you can become available: attention, courage, a boundary, repair, generosity, or care.

blocks.label: Heading: Try this for seven days.
Text: Look for a quieter, more attentive availability - not a dramatic spiritu…
blocks.value: Look for a quieter, more attentive availability - not a dramatic spiritual experience.

meta_description: A simple contemplative practice for becoming present to God and available to love.
